text.id: Pak Aditya. Laporan Bapak saya tarik untuk diperiksa. Bapak ikut kami ke Polsek, kasih keterangan. HP Bapak juga.
text.en: Mr. Aditya. I'm pulling your report for review. You'll come with us to the station and give a statement. Your phone too.

text.id: Dua laki-laki BPM saling lihat, terus jalan balik ke speedboat putih mereka tanpa nunggu bosnya.
text.en: The two BPM men look at each other, then walk back to their white speedboat without waiting for their boss.

text.id: Mbak Sekar. Alat rekam itu tetap sama Anda. Tapi tolong, salinannya buat saya. Yang ini, saya pastikan nggak hilang.
text.en: Ms. Sekar. That recorder stays with you. But please, a copy for me. This one, I'll make sure doesn't disappear.

text.id: Gue yang ngedit. Tasya yang bacain bagian dokumennya, karena suaranya lebih tenang dari suara Sekar kalau lagi marah. Halaman tiga puluh tujuh, dibandingin baris per baris.
text.en: I edited it. Tasya read the document segment, because her voice stays calmer than Sekar's when she's angry. Page thirty-seven, compared line by line.

text.id: Suara Pak Darmawan kita samarkan. Seminggu kemudian dia dateng sendiri ke Ombudsman, pake nama aslinya.
text.en: We disguised Pak Darmawan's voice. A week later he walked into the Ombudsman's office himself, under his own name.

text.id: Suara narsumnya kita samarkan. Seminggu kemudian dia dateng sendiri ke Ombudsman, pake nama aslinya. Sekar nggak kaget. Gue yang kaget.
text.en: We disguised the source's voice. A week later he walked into the Ombudsman's office himself, under his own name. Sekar wasn't surprised. I was.

text.id: Izinnya dibekukan. Patok-patok di depan Muara Angke nggak dicabut semua. Tapi nggak ada yang nambah lagi.
text.en: The permit was frozen. Not all the stakes off Muara Angke came out. But no new ones went in.

text.id: Bima keluar dari kantornya dan ngasih kesaksian. Tasya nolak duit sponsor ketiga. Bu Wulan masak buat sepuluh orang, dan Dinda ngebentak gue karena nambah nasi tiga kali.
text.en: Bima quit his job and gave a statement. Tasya turned down a third sponsor offer. Mrs. Wulan cooked for ten people, and Dinda yelled at me for taking rice three times.

text.id: Sabtu itu Dinda yang bangunin gue jam empat. "Lo udah pernah telat sekali. Gue yang jagain sekarang."
text.en: That Saturday it was Dinda who woke me at four. "You were late once already. I'm on watch now."

text.id: Dia masih ngungkit ancaman yang dulu gue sembunyiin dari dia, seminggu sekali. Sekarang sambil ketawa. Hampir.
text.en: She still brings up the threat I once hid from her, once a week. Laughing now. Almost.

text.id: Gue nggak balik ke Bandung. Kerjaan gue bisa dikerjain dari mana aja. Ternyata yang nggak bisa dikerjain dari mana aja itu yang lain.
text.en: I didn't go back to Bandung. My work can be done from anywhere. It turns out the things that can't be done from anywhere are the other things.

text.id: Sabtu berikutnya, jam lima pagi, dermaga Muara Angke. Pak Karta di kursi roda, diantar Mbak Yanti, ngelambai pake tangan kanan. Sri Rejeki berangkat jam setengah enam. Tepat waktu.
text.en: The next Saturday, five in the morning, the Muara Angke pier. Pak Karta in a wheelchair, pushed by Yanti, waving with his right hand. The Sri Rejeki leaves at five thirty. Right on time.

text.id: Sekar terakhir terlihat Sabtu, 05.30. Sedang merekam.
text.en: Sekar was last seen Saturday, 5:30 AM. Recording.

summary.id: Raka menemukan Sekar, membersihkan nama Pak Hendra dan membuktikan siapa yang membocorkan rekamannya. Episode 12 tayang. Sabtu berikutnya, dia datang jam lima pagi.
summary.en: Raka found Sekar, cleared Pak Hendra and proved who leaked the recording. Episode 12 aired. The next Saturday, he showed up at five in the morning.
